description: This file contains tests for a FastAPI application, specifically testing the behavior of the PUT endpoint for updating items, as well as validation responses and the OpenAPI schema generation. It uses pytest fixtures and the FastAPI TestClient to perform HTTP requests and validate responses.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports a module based on request parameter and creates a TestClient instance for testing the FastAPI app.

methods.name: test_put_all(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the PUT endpoint with a full set of item data, expecting a successful response with echo of the data.

methods.name: test_put_only_required(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the PUT endpoint with only the required fields, verifying default null values for optional fields.

methods.name: test_put_with_no_data(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the PUT endpoint with empty JSON, expecting validation errors for missing required fields.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Validates that the OpenAPI schema generated by the FastAPI application matches the expected structure.
